new.story: A 1978 Italian 50 lire coin showing Vulcan, the Roman god of fire, hammering iron on his anvil. Italy used lire until switching to the euro in 2002.
new.notes: Blind double-read. 1978 / L.50 read directly from coin. Same type as the 1979 filed today.

source: NOID_Italy_1978_50Lire_obv.jpg (owner chat 2026-10-13); Numista N#724: 50 Lire, KM#95.1
